fields.check_day: the day whose saved official-page reads were checked (Asia/Taipei)
fields.checked_at: the moment our crawler read the vendor's official pricing page (Asia/Taipei); empty when the page could not be read
fields.evidence: official page URL + read time; screenshots and page text are kept on our server
fields.plan: plan name as listed on our site
fields.seen: prices read on the official page at checked_at (kind: list / annual / ...)
fields.site_monthly_usd / site_annual_usd: price we publish (annual = per-month equivalent when billed yearly)
fields.type=correction: later rows may correct an earlier row (ref = its key); earlier rows are never edited or deleted
fields.verdict: ok = matches; mismatch = does not match (program check — needs human review before treated as an error); unverified = page or plan could not be read

verdict values.mismatch: our price differs from what the page showed (automated check — needs human review before it is treated as an error)
verdict values.not_found: this plan name + price could not be found on the page this time (not counted as checked)
verdict values.ok: monthly price on our site matches the official page (or plan is free / no fixed price and the plan name was found)
verdict values.ok_annual_only: the page showed only the annual price this time, and it matches our recorded annual price
verdict values.ok_annual_unrecorded: monthly price matches; the page also shows an annual price we have not recorded yet
verdict values.unverified: the official pricing page itself could not be read (anti-bot, timeout or no pricing page on file)

rule: append-only: a new check adds rows; old rows are never overwritten
